tagline: A hands-on, role-based curriculum for governing, securing, and assuring AI — from analyst to Chief AI Officer.
overview: This org covers **AI governance** — *governing, securing and assuring* AI: inventories and risk assessments, red-teaming and adversarial ML, release assurance and evaluation evidence, ML security, agentic safety, enterprise control architecture, and executive leadership of an AI governance program. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.
highlights: 🏛️ Ladder runs from **AI Governance Analyst (L15)** to **Chief AI Officer (L70)**

focus.ai-governance-analyst: AI inventory & intake, risk assessments, fairness review, impact assessments & model cards, regulatory tracking
focus.ai-risk-engineer: Risk frameworks, harm modeling, risk registers, LLM red-teaming, adversarial ML, fairness, privacy risk
focus.ai-evaluation-engineer: Release assurance, assurance cases, release gates, evaluation evidence pipelines, cross-jurisdiction obligations
focus.security: ML security, zero trust, secrets, adversarial ML, runtime security, policy as code, supply chain, SecOps
focus.agentic-safety-engineer: Agent threat modeling, prompt injection & jailbreaks, dangerous-capability evals, excessive-agency containment
focus.senior-ai-governance-architect: AI control libraries, policy as code, multi-jurisdiction reconciliation, AI management systems, risk appetite
focus.head-of-ai-governance: Running the program, board & audit reporting, regulator engagement, regulatory change, program maturity
focus.chief-ai-officer: AI regulation & risk, model risk management, responsible AI, AI security, audit evidence, board reporting

technologies.Regulation & standards: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7
technologies.Infrastructure & secrets: HashiCorp Vault, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions
